ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Iviewers.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "iviewers.dll" (OLE/COM Object Interface Viewer) Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\iviewers\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Windows\\ Kits\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Windows\\ Kits\\\\")))
